message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling:

| Series | Title | Year Published | Notes |
|--------|-------|----------------|-------|
| **Harry Potter** | *Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone* (U.S. title: *Sorcerer’s Stone*) | 1997 | First book in the series; introduces Harry, Hogwarts, and the wizarding world. |
| | *Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets* | 1998 | Harry returns for his second year; the mystery of the Chamber unfolds. |
| | *Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban* | 1999 | Sirius Black’s escape and the introduction of the Marauder’s Map. |
| | *Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire* | 2000 | The Triwizard Tournament and the return of Voldemort. |
| | *Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix* | 2003 | Harry’s fifth year, the rise of the Ministry’s opposition. |
| | *Harry Potter and the Half‑Blood Prince* | 2005 | The backstory of Voldemort and the discovery of Horcruxes. |
| | *Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows* | 2007 | The final battle and the conclusion of the saga. |
| **Cormoran Strike** (written as Robert Galbraith) | *The Cuckoo’s Calling* | 2013 | A detective novel featuring private investigator Cormoran Strike. |
| | *The Silkworm* | 2014 | Strike investigates the disappearance of a bestselling author. |
| | *Career of Evil* | 2015 | Strike and Robin investigate a murder in a small town. |
| | *Lethal White* | 2018 | A political thriller involving a murder in the UK Parliament. |
| | *Troubled Blood* | 2020 | Strike tackles a cold case involving a missing girl. |
| **Other Works** | *The Casual Vacancy* | 2012 | Rowling’s first adult novel, a dark political drama set in a small English town. |
| | *The Ickabog* | 2020 | A fairy‑tale‑style story released as a free online book during the COVID‑19 pandemic. |
| | *The Ickabog* (hardcover) | 2021 | The same story in print format. |

These titles span Rowling’s most famous fantasy series, her crime‑fiction detective novels, and a few standalone works. They have all enjoyed significant commercial success and critical acclaim.
